svg.text: Multiplex amplicon coverage — affected primer shifts: Before → Trial
35 amplicons each; affected primers 2/70 → 0/70; bad dimer pairs 1 → 0
Expansion accepted: Trial is the final panel.
Red primer arrows and underlines = affected in that panel; black = clear. Blue / green amplicon bars = pools 1 / 2.
Links omitted. Hover over primer arrows and PDR boxes for details.
Added PDR span in Trial (purple); hover for original and expanded intervals
Underline = affected primer in that panel; boxes indicate PDRs only
